# Pinned public evidence note: issue #591

- Upstream repo: `https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking`
- Immutable issue URL: `https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/issues/591`
- Capture purpose: freeze the public workaround for the legacy `memory-openviking` path.

## Facts recorded from the public issue

1. The issue reports that after upgrading OpenClaw to `2026.3.12`, the legacy `memory-openviking` plugin can cause conversations to hang.
2. The public workaround recorded in the issue is to downgrade OpenClaw to `2026.3.11`.
3. The note also reflects the ongoing public shift toward the context-engine OpenClaw plugin line.
